data.name: Feliciano
data.gender_notes: Feliciano is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘felix’ which means ‘happy’ or ‘lucky’. In the Bible, there is a biblical figure named Feliciano (or Felicianus) who was a martyr in Sicily during the Diocletian Persecution. The name Feliciano carries the meaning “Joyful, Happy, Fortunate” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Feliciano usually hope their child will grow to embody joyful, happy, fortunate and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes happiness, joy, and a fortunate or blessed life.
data.etymology: Feliciano belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Joyful, Happy, Fortunate.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Feliciano total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_greek.name: Φελισιάνο
in_greek.long_meaning: Φελισιάνο είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από το λατινικό 'Felicianus' και σημαίνει χαρά ή ευτυχία. Το όνομα αυτό ήταν δημοφιλές στην αρχαία Εκκλησία και συνδέεται με την έννοια της ευτυχίας και της χαράς που προέρχεται από τον Θεό. Το όνομα Φελισιάνο είναι επίσης مرتبط με τον Άγιο Φελισιάνο, έναν από τους πρώτους χριστιανούς μάρτυρες.

in_latin.name: Feliciano

in_english.meaning: Feliciano means happy, lucky, or joyful
in_english.long_meaning: Feliciano is a Christian name derived from the Latin word 'felix,' meaning happy, lucky, or joyful. The name Feliciano is associated with several saints, including Saint Feliciano of Foligno, an Italian bishop and martyr. In modern times, the name Feliciano is used globally across various Christian cultures.
